text: Bouki lunged into the pile with both paws.
Instantly, the sticky tree sap seized his fur.
he snarled, kicking with his hind leg.
He struck with his snout, and his jaws sealed shut against the pot.

By the time the golden light of dawn filtered through the leaves of the baobab, Bouki was curled around the jar like a tangled calabash, howling in muffled embarrassment as the village birds gathered above to sing of his folly.
